name: Old Man Gloom
label: Hydra Head
lede: A side project that started in Santa Fe with a drummer and a guitarist, grew into a four-way pile-up of Boston's heaviest bands, and has spent 25 years refusing to tell you when the joke stops.

eras.title: Santa Fe, in under a week
eras.text: Old Man Gloom starts as a two-man project in New Mexico, before two Boston-area heavyweights make it a band. Its first record is 15 tracks of noise, jokes and violence, made fast.

years.h: [[Aaron Turner|db3ca919-a4ab-451a-8f03-e51310cfd866]] and [[Santos Montano|20ef42c2-30e7-4ec3-8faa-af9d2074f9fc]] start a band in Santa Fe
years.p: Turner, then of [[Isis|5e521e8c-0ab2-44c4-8fd8-14d8d3321265]], and drummer Santos Montano form Old Man Gloom in New Mexico. The name nods to Santa Fe's burning-effigy festival.
Turner and Montano write and record the debut in New Mexico in under a week. It came out on Tortuga Recordings, the Hydra Head Records imprint.
years.xp:
Tim Stroh produced and Eric Gallegos engineered. Exclaim! described a record built from quick, jagged sonic barbs and long ambient experiments.

Hydra Head reissued a remastered version on April 7, 2015.

years.p: Newton of [[Converge|fa31e7d4-a03a-4110-98fc-f8826e95ec25]] and Scofield of [[Cave In|f3c95ad4-215b-4519-8660-84c9f467da05]] come in on guitar and bass, turning the duo into a Massachusetts supergroup.

eras.title: Two Seminars and a Christmas
eras.text: With Kurt Ballou behind the board, the band drops two records at once, then a holiday album that is not a joke, or is only partly one.

years.cap: Seminar II: The Holy Rites of Primitivism Regressionism
years.h: Two albums, one day: Seminar II and Seminar III
years.p: Seminar II (17 tracks, 58 minutes) is released alongside Seminar III: Zozobra, a single 27-minute piece.
years.xp:
Kurt Ballou produced both. On Seminar II he engineered most of the tracks; Luke Scarola recorded the rest and added electronics, and became part of the sound through 2004. [[Stephen Brodsky|a0ff602c-7f3e-472d-8786-953da6cd7591]] of Cave In wrote lyrics for the track "Mandied (Self: Reborn)".

Wikipedia dates Seminar II to March 20, 2001 and says it came out simultaneously with Seminar III. AllMusic called the first a roller coaster of ambient drones and metalcore attacks.

years.p: The album is a single long piece of sludge and doom, produced by Ballou and released by Tortuga.
years.xp: Its title gave a later band its name: [[Zozobra|a6b8ef30-1d47-4042-9b29-3963e4cd7a7a]], formed by Scofield in 2006.

years.p: The band's fourth album pairs pummeling epics with noise interludes and ends on a 16-minute piece built from alternate versions of the Christmas Eve segments.
years.xp: Turner, who ran Hydra Head, called it one of the most engaging projects he had been involved with. Reviews split: Drowned in Sound gave it 9/10, Stylus a C+.

eras.title: Never broke up, never around
eras.text: Old Man Gloom never announced a hiatus and never made a record either. Everyone's main bands got busy.

years.h: Scofield starts Zozobra during Cave In's hiatus
years.p: Named after the band's third album, Zozobra gave Caleb Scofield an outlet while [[Cave In|f3c95ad4-215b-4519-8660-84c9f467da05]] was on hiatus. Santos Montano played in it briefly.

years.h: [[Isis|5e521e8c-0ab2-44c4-8fd8-14d8d3321265]] dissolves; Turner is free for more Gloom
years.p: Turner's main band ends in 2010, after Panopticon, In the Absence of Truth and Wavering Radiant came out during Old Man Gloom's quiet years.
years.xp:
Meanwhile Newton's Converge released You Fail Me, No Heroes and Axe to Fall, and he started [[Doomriders|64ddf06c-850f-46ab-9552-10ef69647d8b]] in 2004.

Turner has said of the gap that the band did things when they felt like it.

eras.title: Surprise: No
eras.text: After eight years, the band comes back with almost no warning, then plays a deliberate trick on the press.

years.h: Kurt Ballou tweets about a new record, then says it was a joke
years.p: The band records No at Ballou's God City Studio in 2011. Hints of a new album (a magazine ad Easter egg, a Ballou tweet he called an April Fools' joke) circulate first.

years.cap: Old Man Gloom photographed in Montreal, Quebec, Canada at the Bar Le Ritz PDB. · Wikimedia
years.h: Album announced on Facebook, tour starts the next day
years.p: On May 1, 2012 the band announces No. Shows begin May 2, and copies are sold on tour before release.
years.xp: Turner told The Quietus the reunion "fell together very naturally", with more ease than the early days.

years.p: The band's fifth album, produced by Ballou, is released by Hydra Head as HH666-235. Nine tracks, 56 minutes.
years.xp: Kevin Baker of The Hope Conspiracy, Ballou, and Mike McKenzie of The Red Chord are credited as guests. Pitchfork gave it 7.2.

years.h: The Ape of God: two albums, and a fake one for the press
years.p: Old Man Gloom release two records both titled The Ape of God on Profound Lore Records, after sending critics an edited, eight-track version to fool leakers.
years.xp:
The band recorded with Kurt Ballou in December 2013 and June 2014. The promo version mixed edited songs from both albums, and Turner told MetalSucks there were alternate versions when it suspected a double album. Decibel's Adrien Begrand criticized the ruse; Newton has said people either love the joke or are angry about it.

The official releases went to Profound Lore, with vinyl on SIGE. Rolling Stone ranked them fourth on its 2014 metal list.

years.h: Hydra Head reissues a remastered Meditations in B
years.p: The debut gets a remaster on Hydra Head, 15 years after the first Tortuga pressing.

eras.title: Caleb
eras.text: The band loses its bassist, decides to continue, and records with a member of Cave In in his place.

years.h: Caleb Scofield dies at 39 in New Hampshire
years.p: The Old Man Gloom, Cave In and Zozobra bassist and vocalist died on March 28, 2018 when his truck crashed at a toll booth in Bedford.
years.xp:
Rolling Stone reported the truck collided with a toll booth. Wikipedia gives the cause of death as smoke and heat inhalation, thermal injuries and multiple blunt impact injuries. A crowdfunding campaign for his family raised roughly $72,000, per Wikipedia.

Montano has said Scofield had quietly asked him about continuing Old Man Gloom, and that they felt they had to.

years.cap: Old Man Gloom photographed in Montreal, Quebec, Canada at the Bar Le Ritz PDB. · Wikimedia
years.h: Boston tribute: Converge, Cave In and a reunited Cancer Conspiracy
years.p: A benefit show for Scofield's family on June 13, 2018 features Converge and Young Widows. His brother Kyle, Newton and Stephen Brodsky cover bass.
years.xp: A Los Angeles benefit followed October 13, 2018 with Pelican, 27 and Celestial, an Isis reunion under another name.

years.h: Stephen Brodsky of Cave In joins on bass
years.p: Brodsky, who played the Boston tribute show, is confirmed as a member and starts on a new record.

years.h: Seminar IX: Darkness of Being drops online first
years.p: The surprise release on Profound Lore Records is the first of two 2020 records, and the first with Brodsky.

years.h: Seminar VIII: Light of Meaning is the tribute
years.p: The companion album folds in Scofield's posthumous contributions; Louder Sound singled out the Cave In-flavored "Final Defeat".

sources.title: Rolling Stone: Caleb Scofield dead at 39
